_desc: Per-node modem TX-failure injection (Wave-4 §6.1.2). nodes[].tx_fail_prob parsed + range-validated by JsonConfig but never reached the radio: the roll lived only inside SimRadio::startSendRaw, which the live TX path bypasses. Two identical senders differing ONLY in tx_fail_prob (1.0 vs absent) prove the key now reaches the radio and that a failed arm removes the frame from the air while emitting tx_fail. Metal semantics (lib/hal/device_hal.cpp pump_tx): a failed arm DROPS the frame and does NOT notify the protocol, and does NOT debit the duty ledger. Analytically deterministic: no fading, no PER sigmoid, no preamble miss, no startup jitter, no warmup, duty 100%. ★ Runs on the DEPRECATED Lua engine BY NECESSITY (build_test.sh cannot link FirmwareNode) — hence the explicit per-node "engine":"lua" plus allow_deprecated_lua, the sanctioned internal use of that opt-in (same precedent as test_bw_mismatch).
